## 1. What he must carry for them, and the documents-only answer

| His answer | What it is offered for | Our answer from the papers |
|---|---|---|
| S10, S11, S13: the SPA was shown to Gloria | That the buyer knew of, and relied on, the SPA | Good for us. If she saw the SPA, she saw ¶7 (the class, prior consultation). Art. 1898 turns on the buyer's knowledge of the agent's limits. _Do not object; use it._ |
| S14, S15: around 1992, at Llamanzares's house, they "napag-alaman" the Balanes had agreed to buy and had paid a down payment | Class membership | Hearsay (what Llamanzares or his papers said). The papers they went to fetch are the best proof (Original Document Rule, Rule 130 §3). None is attached. His letter says the class held Llamanzares-issued contracts or receipts. Subpoena (k) asks for them; if they are not produced, Rule 131 §3(e). |
| S16: Cesar sold "alinsunod sa kanilang naunang kasunduan kay Ben Llamanzares" | Same | Same answer. Which agreement, signed by whom, on what date? |
| S19 to S22: he collected rent and partial payments and issued Exh. 5 | Payment of the price | His own words: "mga bayad sa upa at ng mga partial payment." The earliest slip is October 2003, signed "Von dela Fuente." The only "Down payment" is 6 January 2005, from his side. None is from Llamanzares. 'Full payment' is dated February 2017, after a deed reciting payment "in hand." |
| S24, S25: part of the money paid the amilyar and estate tax, because the land was at risk of auction | Good faith; benefit to the owners | Treasurer's statement, 31 July 2019 (Tab 6): the heirs' remaining Barangay 1 land unpaid 1994 to 2019. ARP 00246 (Tab 5): back taxes paid on the 2,587 sq m being sold, under ORs 0033799 to 0033800. Exh. 5 receipt 0129 (₱40,000 from Gloria) is dated 31 March 2016, the day the Treasurer's ledger records the lot's 2012 to 2016 tax paid under OR 0033800. |
| S29: after notarization his father "ipinalakad na niya sa iba" the transfer | Distance from the 2020 and 2021 filings | Who is "iba"? Registration was on 23 November 2021, four years after Cesar died (21 June 2017). See Part 5 (Atty. Belen). |
| S30 to S32: no one questioned the SPA; he never saw any owner give authority; Cesar dealt with the Agcaoili office; no notice of revocation | Good faith | S31 concedes that no owner was ever consulted ("Wala po"). S32 is about his family's knowledge, not the Balanes'. Do not argue the revocation through him. |
